description: This file defines the 'FileDescriptor' class, a wrapper around a file descriptor to manage its validity and lifetime safely. It provides methods for construction, assignment, validation, resetting, releasing, and destruction of file descriptors, ensuring safe passing and handling within the application.

classes.name: FileDescriptor
classes.description: A wrapper class for managing a file descriptor safely, including duplication, validation, and release.

methods.name: FileDescriptor()
methods.description: Default constructor, initializes with invalid file descriptor.

methods.name: explicit FileDescriptor(int fd)
methods.description: Constructor that duplicates the provided file descriptor for safe management.

methods.name: FileDescriptor(const FileDescriptor &other)
methods.description: Copy constructor, duplicates the file descriptor from another instance.

methods.name: FileDescriptor &operator=(FileDescriptor &&other) noexcept
methods.description: Move assignment operator, transfers ownership of the file descriptor.

methods.name: FileDescriptor &operator=(const FileDescriptor &other)
methods.description: Copy assignment operator, duplicates the file descriptor from another instance.

methods.name: ~FileDescriptor()
methods.description: Destructor, closes the file descriptor if valid.

methods.name: bool isValid() const
methods.description: Checks if the file descriptor is valid.

methods.name: void reset(int fd = -1)
methods.description: Resets the object with a new file descriptor, closing the old one if necessary.

methods.name: void clear()
methods.description: Clears the file descriptor, setting it to invalid.

methods.name: int release()
methods.description: Releases ownership of the file descriptor without closing it.
